snippet.title: Legacy of Valor – Official PlayTest Trailer | Join the Playtest on Discord
snippet.description:
Hello, my name is Filip and I am developer of the medieval RPG Legacy of Valor. 

Right now on Kickstarter.
Join the Legacy of Valor on Kickstarter and become part of the journey.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/legacyofvalorgame/legacy-of-valor-medieval-rpg-build-conquer-rule

⚔️ Legacy of Valor is a medieval RPG where your actions shape the world.
🛡 Build your stronghold.
⚒ Expand your land.
🏘 Rule your village.
⚔ Lead armies into epic battles.
👑 Gain power, build a family, and leave your legacy.

Your choices matter.
Your story is your destiny.

🔥 This trailer features gameplay from the prototype.

🧪 Become a playtester. Join our Discord and fill out the short application form:
👉 https://discord.com/invite/ykYjpqvCUG

✅ Wishlist us on Steam to support the project: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504490/Legacy_of_Valor/

📣 Follow us:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/legacy_of_valor_game/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504490/Legacy_of_Valor/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ykYjpqvCUG
